## About the Site

Dr. Herlon Moura is an angiologist and vascular surgeon based in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.
This site provides educational content about vascular health, varicose veins, blood clots (DVT),
and offers interactive tools for risk assessment.

- Address: R. Eng. Célso Tôrres, 654 - Graça, Salvador BA, 40150-000, Brasil
- Email: contato@herlonmoura.com.br

## Key Topics

- Angiology and vascular surgery
- Varicose vein treatment (laser, sclerotherapy, microsurgery)
- Deep vein thrombosis (DVT) risk assessment
- Vascular disease prevention
- Doppler ultrasound
- Minimally invasive vascular procedures
- Patient education and health literacy
